title: Small object factorizations for a set in a locally presentable category
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with Hom sets in a fixed universe $\mathcal U$ and all $\mathcal U$-small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose $\mathcal C$ is locally presentable: for some infinite regular $\kappa\in\mathcal U$, a $\mathcal U$-small set of objects whose Hom functors preserve $\kappa$-filtered colimits generates every object under such colimits; $\kappa$-filtered means every diagram of fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms admits a cocone, and regular means a union of fewer than $\kappa$ sets of cardinality less than $\kappa$ still has cardinality less than $\kappa$. Let $I$ be a $\mathcal U$-small set of morphisms of $\mathcal C$. Write $R=I^{\square}$ for the morphisms admitting a diagonal filler in every commutative square with left side in $I$, and $L={}^{\square}R$ for those admitting a filler against every right side in $R$. There is a functorial factorization $f=p_f i_f$ of every morphism, with $i_f\in L$ and $p_f\in R$. Functorial means every commutative square $(a,b):f\to g$ induces a map $m(a,b)$ of middle objects satisfying $m(a,b)i_f=i_g a$ and $p_gm(a,b)=bp_f$, preserving identities and composition.
